mentl/d6117f5:
Per BT-bootstrap-triage.md §11.4 BT.A.0 + Hβ-bootstrap.md §13 step 3
(commit 95fdc3c).

Runs the seed compiler against each src/*.nx + lib/**/*.nx file;
categorizes failure shape; outputs TSV + summary on stderr.

Categories:
  VALIDATES        — output passes wat2wasm + wasm-validate cleanly
  PARSE-INCOMPLETE — undefined locals from import-as-identifier handling
  WAT-MALFORMED    — wat2wasm rejects on syntactic grounds beyond imports
  CROSS-MODULE-REF — wat2wasm accepts; wasm-validate rejects on missing symbols
  STDIN-EMPTY-OUT  — seed produced no output
  SEED-CRASH       — wasmtime exited non-zero

Survey results 2026-04-25 (50 .nx files):
  VALIDATES         11 files (verify.nx + 10 tutorial stubs)
  PARSE-INCOMPLETE  35 files (parser fails on imports)
  WAT-MALFORMED      4 files (different parser failure mode)
  CROSS-MODULE-REF   0 files (parser fails before reaching this stage)

Per BT §11.4: PARSE-INCOMPLETE files block on Hβ §1 parser conventions
extension. The work is corrective per Hβ §13 step 4 (Hβ.parse +
module-symbol resolution). CROSS-MODULE-REF will surface only after
parser extension produces well-formed per-file outputs.

The script's output drives BT.A.1 substrate-extension work — failure
category by failure category. Per the substrate-honesty discipline:
honest measurement before substantive substrate work.

sonido/d68fd96:
Complete migration from ProcessingEngine/ChainManager to ProcessingGraph/GraphEngine
across every consumer in the workspace. This is the architectural shift from linear
Vec<Box<dyn Effect>> chains to compiled DAG schedules with topological sort, buffer
liveness analysis, and latency compensation.

Core changes:
- Move EffectWithParams trait from sonido-registry to sonido-core (enables
  ProcessingGraph to store effects with both Effect + ParameterInfo vtables)
- Extend ProcessingGraph with EffectWithParams-aware API: effect_with_params(),
  effect_with_params_mut(), per-node bypass with crossfade
- Extend GraphEngine with chain management: add_effect(), remove_effect(),
  reorder(), from_chain() migration path, process_file() for CLI

Consumer migrations:
- CLI (play, process, realtime): ProcessingEngine → GraphEngine, block-based
  processing with pre-allocated scratch buffers (fixes 48k allocs/sec in play)
- GUI AudioProcessor: ProcessingEngine → GraphEngine, node_map tracks
  slot→NodeId mapping with swap_remove consistency (fixes critical desync bug)
- GUI ChainManager: stripped to ChainCommand enum only (all management moved
  to GraphEngine)
- Plugin chain: ProcessingEngine → ProcessingGraph direct, trait-upcast for
  Effect access, let-chain patterns for nested option handling
- Registry: EffectWithParams re-exported from core, factory returns
  Box<dyn EffectWithParams + Send>

Removals:
- ProcessingEngine (crates/sonido-io/src/engine.rs) — deleted
- ChainManager impl, ChainSlot, all associated methods and tests

BREAKING CHANGE: ProcessingEngine removed. All consumers must use GraphEngine
(high-level chain management) or ProcessingGraph (direct DAG API). EffectWithParams
now lives in sonido-core, not sonido-registry.

two-top/d6c7727:
Multishot throws a recallable primary fang plus two fire-and-forget
side-fangs at +/-15 degrees. Side-fangs (is_secondary) are ignored by
recall/catch, despawn on first wall contact, and carry a 120-frame

entity on scrub-restore).
tokensafe/d619b4b:
Product restructure driven by production testing: batch has a flat-pricing
problem ($0.04 punishes small batches), monitor is check + 20 lines of
diffing, and cached monitor results undercut the paid check. Two endpoints
now, not four.

Endpoint surgery:
- Remove /v1/batch and /v1/monitor routes, x402 pricing, MCP tools, tests
- Delete monitor.ts orchestrator (delta.ts pure functions kept)
- Rename monitor-cache exports → checkHistory* (delta detection now serves check)

Check enrichment:
- Every paid check includes changes/alerts relative to previous snapshot
- First call returns changes: null; subsequent calls (after cache expiry)
  report field-level delta with severity-ranked alerts
- Don't cache degraded results — transient RPC failures shouldn't poison
  the 5-minute window

Bug fixes:
- top_holders: catch "Too many accounts" RPC error → return SAFE with 5M
  estimate (extreme distribution is a positive signal, not degraded)
- TLV parser: move typeId=0 check before offset advancement — was reading
  garbage length bytes and skipping past real extensions
- token age: established tokens return null time fields — oldest of last
  100 sigs is minutes old for active tokens, reporting it as created_at
  is misleading

14 files changed, -805/+171 lines. 212 tests pass.

BREAKING CHANGE: /v1/batch and /v1/monitor endpoints removed. Use /v1/check
(now includes delta detection) or /v1/check/lite (free).
